items.title_cn: 中国DeepSeek引发AI股广泛抛售，美股应声下挫
items.title_en: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
items.summary_cn: 中国AI公司DeepSeek以低成本模型引发市场对AI算力投资逻辑的质疑，导致美股AI相关板块全面下挫。本文剖析了抛售的触发机制与传导路径，揭示了市场对AI商业化前景的深层焦虑。值得关注的是，这轮波动不仅反映地缘科技竞争加剧，更预示着AI投资从狂热叙事向成本效益审视的转折，对全球科技股估值体系构成压力测试。
items.summary_en: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek's low-cost model has triggered a broad selloff in US AI-related stocks, challenging the investment logic behind AI computing power. This article analyzes the triggers and transmission channels of the rout, revealing deep-seated market anxiety over AI commercialization prospects. The volatility not only reflects intensifying geopolitical tech competition but also signals a shift in AI investment from hype-driven narratives to cost-effectiveness scrutiny, stress-testing global tech stock valuations.

items.title_cn: Comex黄金与白银期货收低
items.title_en: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
items.summary_cn: Comex黄金与白银期货当日双双收低，反映市场对美联储利率路径预期、美元走势及避险情绪变化的重新定价。贵金属短线承压值得关注，因其往往预示实际利率与流动性预期的边际转向，对资产配置与通胀交易具有参考意义。
items.summary_en: Comex gold and silver futures both settled lower, reflecting a repricing of expectations around the Federal Reserve's rate path, dollar moves, and shifts in safe-haven sentiment. The near-term pressure on precious metals is worth watching, as it often signals marginal turns in real-rate and liquidity expectations, offering reference value for asset allocation and inflation trades.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek 不会击沉美国 AI 巨头
items.title_en: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
items.summary_cn: 本文深入剖析了 DeepSeek 的崛起对美国 AI 巨头的影响，指出尽管 DeepSeek 在成本效率上表现突出，但其技术路线和市场定位并不足以颠覆美国头部企业的竞争优势。文章从算力壁垒、生态护城河和商业化能力三个维度展开论证，认为美国 AI 巨头凭借深厚的资源积累和成熟的商业闭环，仍将主导全球 AI 格局。对于关注中美 AI 竞争与投资趋势的读者，本文提供了冷静而独到的判断，值得一读。
items.summary_en: This article provides an in-depth analysis of DeepSeek's rise and its impact on U.S. AI giants, arguing that despite DeepSeek's notable cost efficiency, its technical approach and market positioning are not enough to disrupt the competitive advantages of leading American companies. The article builds its case from three dimensions: computing power barriers, ecosystem moats, and commercialization capabilities, concluding that U.S. AI titans will continue to dominate the global AI landscape thanks to their deep resource accumulation and mature business loops. For readers interested in U.S.-China AI competition and investment trends, this piece offers a calm and insightful perspective worth reading.

items.title_cn: 金融服务综述：市场观察
items.title_en: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
items.summary_cn: 该内容为金融服务领域的市场动态综述，汇集了行业最新资讯与观点。对于关注金融板块的投资者而言，此类汇总有助于快速把握市场情绪与关键变化，值得一看以了解当日金融服务行业的重要讨论焦点。
items.summary_en: This content is a roundup of market updates and commentary in the financial services sector, gathering the latest industry news and views. For investors focused on financials, such a digest helps quickly gauge market sentiment and key developments, making it worth reading to catch the important discussion points in financial services for the day.

items.title_cn: 美哥关税争端推动阿拉比卡咖啡价格创历史新高
items.title_en: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
items.summary_cn: 阿拉比卡咖啡期货价格因美国与哥伦比亚之间的关税争端创下历史纪录。这场贸易摩擦威胁到全球最大咖啡生产国之一的出口供应，引发市场对供应链中断的担忧。值得关注的是，关税壁垒如何通过产业链传导至消费端，以及咖啡价格飙升对全球食品通胀和下游企业的潜在冲击。
items.summary_en: Arabica coffee futures hit an all-time high amid a tariff dispute between the U.S. and Colombia, threatening exports from one of the world's largest coffee producers and raising concerns over supply chain disruptions. The key takeaway is how tariff barriers transmit through the supply chain to consumers, and the potential impact of surging coffee prices on global food inflation and downstream businesses.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek消息提振避险需求，瑞士法郎与日元走强
items.title_en: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
items.summary_cn: DeepSeek相关消息引发市场避险情绪升温，瑞士法郎和日元作为传统避险货币应声上涨。这一走势值得关注，因为它反映了市场对科技领域不确定性可能波及更广泛经济与金融稳定的担忧，同时也凸显了在当前环境下，避险资产配置逻辑正受到新兴技术消息的驱动，投资者需留意汇率波动加剧的风险。
items.summary_en: News related to DeepSeek has heightened market risk aversion, driving up the Swiss franc and Japanese yen as traditional safe-haven currencies. This move is noteworthy as it reflects concerns that uncertainty in the tech sector could spill over into broader economic and financial stability. It also highlights that safe-haven asset allocation is being increasingly driven by emerging technology news, and investors should watch for heightened exchange rate volatility.

items.title_cn: 天气预测变化致天然气价格下跌
items.title_en: Natural Gas Falls on Shifting Weather Forecasts
items.summary_cn: 近期天然气价格因天气预测调整而出现下跌，市场对供暖需求的预期减弱是主要推手。天气模型显示未来气温可能高于此前预测，导致取暖用气需求前景转淡，交易员随之调整头寸。这一波动凸显了天气因素对能源市场的敏感影响，也提醒投资者关注短期预测变化对价格的双向冲击。在供需格局尚未根本改变的背景下，天气驱动的价格波动或为关注能源板块的投资者提供交易窗口，但需警惕预测反复带来的风险。
items.summary_en: Natural gas prices recently fell as weather forecasts shifted, with reduced expectations for heating demand being the main driver. Weather models indicate temperatures may be higher than previously predicted, dimming the outlook for heating fuel demand and prompting traders to adjust positions. This volatility highlights the sensitive impact of weather on energy markets and reminds investors to watch for two-way price shocks from short-term forecast changes. With supply-demand fundamentals not fundamentally altered, weather-driven price swings may offer trading windows for energy-sector investors, but the risk of forecast reversals warrants caution.

items.title_cn: 建材分销商QXO对Beacon发起敌意收购
items.title_en: Building-Products Distributor QXO Launches Hostile Bid for Beacon
items.summary_cn: 建材分销商QXO对竞争对手Beacon发起敌意收购，此举可能重塑行业格局。值得关注的是，QXO作为一家相对较新的市场参与者，采取如此激进的收购策略，反映出建材分销领域竞争加剧和整合趋势。敌意收购的成功与否将取决于Beacon股东的反应以及潜在的监管审查，此事件可能引发行业内的连锁反应，影响其他分销商的战略布局。
items.summary_en: Building-products distributor QXO has launched a hostile bid for rival Beacon, a move that could reshape the industry landscape. It is worth noting that QXO, a relatively new market player, adopting such an aggressive acquisition strategy reflects intensifying competition and consolidation trends in the building-products distribution sector. The success of the hostile bid will depend on Beacon shareholders' response and potential regulatory scrutiny, and the event may trigger chain reactions within the industry, affecting the strategic positioning of other distributors.

items.title_cn: 中国如何借助峰会扩大全球影响力
items.title_en: How China is using summits to expand its global influence
items.summary_cn: 本文剖析中国如何通过主办和参与国际峰会，将外交舞台转化为扩大全球影响力的战略工具。文章以习近平主席协调具有全球意义的合影为例，揭示峰会外交背后的深层逻辑：不仅展示大国形象，更通过议程设置、双边会晤和媒体传播，塑造国际叙事、争取伙伴关系。值得关注的是，这种软实力投射方式如何影响地缘政治格局，以及西方应如何解读中国日益娴熟的峰会外交策略。
items.summary_en: This article examines how China uses hosting and participating in international summits as a strategic tool to expand its global influence. Using President Xi Jinping's coordination of another globally significant photo-op as an example, it reveals the underlying logic of summit diplomacy: not only projecting a major-power image but also shaping international narratives and building partnerships through agenda-setting, bilateral meetings, and media outreach. It is worth reading for insights into how this soft-power projection affects the geopolitical landscape and how the West should interpret China's increasingly sophisticated summit diplomacy.

items.title_cn: AI抛售潮令2026年股市预测市场前景黯淡
items.title_en: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
items.summary_cn: 受AI板块抛售影响，预测市场对美股2026年走势的预期显著降温。Kalshi平台上标普500指数突破8000点的概率曾超70%，如今已跌至极低水平。这一变化值得关注，因为它反映了市场情绪从乐观转向谨慎，AI热潮的退潮可能预示更广泛的估值调整，投资者需警惕科技股主导的风险偏好逆转。
items.summary_en: Amid an AI sell-off, prediction markets have significantly dimmed their outlook for U.S. stocks in 2026. On Kalshi, the odds of the S&P 500 crossing 8,000, once above 70%, have fallen to extremely low levels. This shift is noteworthy as it signals a turn from optimism to caution, with the AI rally's fade potentially heralding broader valuation adjustments and a reversal in tech-led risk appetite that investors should watch.

items.title_cn: 沃什呼吁美联储官员少发声，他们却反其道而行之
items.title_en: Warsh wants Fed officials to talk less. Instead, they’re talking more
items.summary_cn: 美联储理事沃什主张官员应减少公开讲话以避免市场过度反应，但近期多位美联储官员却频繁发声，而主席则保持低调。这一反差凸显美联储内部沟通策略的分歧，可能影响市场对政策信号的解读，值得关注其背后动机与潜在影响。
items.summary_en: Fed Governor Warsh advocates for fewer public speeches by officials to avoid overreactions in markets, yet several Fed officials have recently been speaking frequently while the chairman stays on the sidelines. This contrast highlights divisions in the Fed's communication strategy and could affect how markets interpret policy signals, making it worth watching the motivations and potential implications.

items.title_cn: 牛市新难题：聪明钱正在离场，股票供应激增考验市场承接力
items.title_en: The bull market has a new problem. The 'smart money' is selling
items.summary_cn: 美股牛市出现结构性变化：企业正从股票回购转向增发新股，市场供给增加。与此同时，Anthropic高达810亿美元的IPO将检验需求端的成色。这一转变值得关注，因为回购曾是本轮牛市的重要支撑，而供给放量叠加聪明钱减持，可能意味着市场正从供不应求转向供需再平衡，投资者需警惕流动性边际收紧对估值的压制。
items.summary_en: A structural shift is emerging in the U.S. bull market: companies are moving from share buybacks to equity issuance, adding new supply. Meanwhile, Anthropic's $81 billion IPO will test the strength of demand. This is worth watching because buybacks had been a key pillar of this bull run; rising supply combined with 'smart money' selling may signal a transition from shortage to rebalancing, and investors should watch for tighter liquidity weighing on valuations.

items.title_cn: 特朗普亚洲之行落幕：美中贸易、台湾问题与科技紧张局势仍未解决
items.title_en: U.S.-China trade, Taiwan and tech tensions remain unresolved as Trump returns from Asia
items.summary_cn: 特朗普结束亚洲之行，尽管在APEC期间举行了高调的三边及其他会议，但分析人士指出成果寥寥。美中在贸易、台湾问题及科技领域的紧张关系依然悬而未决，缺乏具体突破。值得关注的是，此次访问未能缓解核心分歧，未来双边关系仍面临不确定性，投资者需警惕政策风险对市场的影响。
items.summary_en: Trump concluded his Asia trip with few concrete outcomes from the high-profile trilateral and other meetings during APEC, according to analysts. Tensions between the U.S. and China over trade, Taiwan, and technology remain unresolved, with no specific breakthroughs. Notably, the visit failed to ease core disagreements, leaving future bilateral relations uncertain and investors alert to policy risks affecting markets.

items.title_cn: 特朗普与普京会晤后盛赞双方关系良好，乌克兰战争成焦点
items.title_en: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
items.summary_cn: 美国总统特朗普周四分别与俄罗斯总统普京和中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。会后特朗普高度评价与普京的“良好关系”，而乌克兰战争成为此次外交活动的核心议题。值得关注的是，特朗普在俄乌冲突持续之际与普京直接对话，可能预示美国对俄政策及战争走向出现重大调整，同时中美俄三边互动也释放出复杂的地缘政治信号。
items.summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump met separately on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping. After the meeting, Trump praised his 'great relationship' with Putin, with the Ukraine war taking center stage in the diplomatic activity. The direct dialogue between Trump and Putin amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict could signal a major shift in U.S. policy toward Russia and the war's trajectory, while the trilateral interactions among the U.S., Russia, and China also send complex geopolitical signals.

items.title_cn: 美联储会议纪要：官员预计将进一步加息，并担忧AI对通胀的影响
items.title_en: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
items.summary_cn: 美联储10月会议纪要显示，官员们预计需要进一步加息以控制通胀，同时首次表达了对人工智能可能推高通胀的担忧。纪要透露，决策者认为AI技术可能通过提升效率降低通胀，但也可能因需求激增或市场集中度上升而加剧价格压力。这一讨论凸显美联储在权衡科技变革对货币政策的影响，值得关注未来政策路径中AI因素的角色。
items.summary_en: The minutes of the Fed's October meeting show that officials expect further rate hikes to control inflation and for the first time expressed concerns that artificial intelligence could push up inflation. Policymakers believe AI could lower inflation by boosting efficiency, but it could also intensify price pressures through surging demand or increased market concentration. This discussion highlights the Fed's consideration of technology's impact on monetary policy, making it worth watching how AI factors into the future policy path.

items.title_cn: 我在中国目睹特朗普、习近平与普京同台：三大关键观察
items.title_en: I watched Trump, Xi and Putin gather in China. Here are my top takeaways
items.summary_cn: 本文作者亲历特朗普、习近平与普京即将在中国举行的罕见三边会晤，从现场视角提炼出三大关键观察。文章不仅梳理了会晤的象征意义与地缘政治信号，还分析了三方在贸易、安全与全球秩序上的微妙博弈。为何值得看：这是近年来首次中美俄领导人同框，可能重塑大国互动框架，对市场与外交政策均有深远影响。
items.summary_en: The author witnesses the rare trilateral meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin in China and distills three key takeaways from the scene. The piece examines the symbolic significance and geopolitical signals of the summit, as well as the delicate bargaining among the three powers over trade, security and global order. Why it matters: this is the first time in recent years that the leaders of the U.S., China and Russia appear together, potentially reshaping great-power interaction and carrying far-reaching implications for markets and foreign policy.

items.title_cn: 澳大利亚反对党呼吁修改天然气保留计划
items.title_en: Australian Opposition Calls for Changes to Gas Reservation Plan
items.summary_cn: 澳大利亚反对党联盟在立法投票前对政府要求液化天然气出口商增加国内供应的计划提出更多担忧。该计划旨在保障国内能源安全，但反对党认为现行方案可能抑制投资、扭曲市场。本文值得关注，因为它揭示了资源国在出口与内需之间的政策博弈，以及政治分歧如何影响关键能源立法走向。
items.summary_en: Australia's opposition coalition has raised further concerns about the government's plan requiring liquefied natural gas exporters to boost domestic supply, ahead of a legislative vote this week. The plan aims to safeguard domestic energy security, but the opposition argues the current approach could deter investment and distort the market. This is worth reading because it highlights the policy tension resource nations face between exports and domestic needs, and how political divisions shape critical energy legislation.

items.title_cn: 中国AI概念股1.7万亿美元暴跌：昔日热门交易沦为输家策略
items.title_en: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
items.summary_cn: 曾因中国科技巨头竞相追赶美国而备受追捧的中国AI股票交易，如今已演变为一种失败策略，市值蒸发高达1.7万亿美元。本文深入剖析了这一戏剧性逆转背后的多重因素，包括估值泡沫破裂、盈利前景不明、监管压力以及全球地缘政治紧张局势。文章不仅揭示了市场情绪的急剧转变，更探讨了投资者应如何重新评估中国AI领域的风险与机遇。对于关注中国科技股和全球AI投资趋势的读者而言，这是一篇不可多得的警示与反思之作。
items.summary_en: The once-hot trade in Chinese AI stocks, fueled by the race of the nation’s tech giants to catch up with the US, has morphed into a losing strategy, erasing $1.7 trillion in market value. This article delves into the multiple factors behind the dramatic reversal, including the bursting of valuation bubbles, uncertain profitability, regulatory pressures, and global geopolitical tensions. It not only reveals the sharp shift in market sentiment but also explores how investors should reassess the risks and opportunities in China’s AI sector. A must-read warning and reflection for those following Chinese tech stocks and global AI investment trends.

items.title_cn: 俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾遭无人机袭击，凸显波罗的海航运风险加剧
items.title_en: Russian Cargo Ship Attacked By Drones in Gulf of Finland
items.summary_cn: 俄罗斯称一艘驶往加里宁格勒飞地的货船在芬兰湾国际水域遭无人机袭击。此事凸显俄通过波罗的海关键航线进行能源和粮食出口的风险日益上升。值得关注的是，袭击发生在国际水域，可能进一步加剧地区紧张局势，并影响全球供应链稳定，尤其是能源和粮食市场。
items.summary_en: Russia said a cargo ship bound for its Kaliningrad exclave was targeted in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, highlighting growing risks to the country's energy and food exports through critical Baltic Sea shipping routes. The attack in international waters is noteworthy as it may further escalate regional tensions and affect global supply chain stability, particularly in energy and food markets.

items.title_cn: Anthropic未能平息AI焦虑，感恩节不谈“下厨”
items.title_en: Anthropic Fails to Calm AI Jitters, Ditching the Kitchen for Thanksgiving
items.summary_cn: 彭博周末直播节目聚焦市场休市后仍持续发酵的新闻。本期嘉宾包括Just Ice Tea联合创始人Seth Goldman与Spike Mendelsohn、Seaport Research Partners董事总经理兼首席股票策略师Jonathan Golub、《纽约客》专职撰稿人Jon Lee Anderson以及《大西洋月刊》特约撰稿人Kim Ghattas。节目从AI焦虑切入，探讨Anthropic未能安抚市场情绪的背后原因，并延伸至感恩节消费与宏观策略。值得看的是，多位跨领域嘉宾提供了从科技到消费再到地缘政治的多维视角，帮助观众在周末快速把握下周市场脉络。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg's weekend live show brings clarity and context to the biggest headlines even after markets close. Guests include Just Ice Tea co-founders Seth Goldman and Spike Mendelsohn, Seaport Research Partners Managing Director and Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub, The New Yorker staff writer Jon Lee Anderson, and The Atlantic contributing writer Kim Ghattas. The episode examines why Anthropic failed to calm AI jitters, touching on Thanksgiving consumer trends and macro strategy. It is worth watching for the multi-dimensional perspectives spanning tech, consumer and geopolitics, helping viewers quickly grasp the market narrative for the week ahead.

items.title_cn: 一针见血！彭博社每周新闻测验，专为敢冒险的你打造
items.title_en: Pointed! Bloomberg’s Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
items.summary_cn: 彭博社推出全新新闻测验栏目“Pointed”，在传统新闻知识测试基础上加入策略性维度，不仅考察玩家对新闻的掌握程度，更考验其对答案的信心程度。由Lisa Mateo、Christina Ruffini和David Gura主持，玩家可前往Bloomberg.com亲自体验。该测验的创新之处在于将“知识”与“自信”双重考量，让新闻阅读从被动接收变为主动判断，值得一看。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg introduces 'Pointed,' a new weekly news quiz that adds a strategic twist to the traditional format by testing not only players' knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Hosted by Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini, and David Gura, the quiz is available to play at Bloomberg.com. Its innovation lies in the dual assessment of knowledge and confidence, transforming news consumption from passive reception into active judgment—making it worth checking out.

items.title_cn: 高盛与阿波罗定价320亿美元SpaceX债券，为AI芯片采购融资
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs, Apollo Price $32 Billion SpaceX Bonds to Fund AI Chip Purchases
items.summary_cn: 高盛与阿波罗历经一年多设计，为SpaceX定价320亿美元债券，专项用于采购AI芯片而不恶化资产负债表。这一创新融资结构解决了科技行业AI军备竞赛中的核心痛点——如何在不损害信用评级的前提下获取算力。交易规模罕见，凸显AI基础设施投资正从股权融资转向结构化债务，值得关注其对科技企业融资模式和债券市场的示范效应。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs and Apollo priced $32 billion in bonds for SpaceX after more than a year of structuring, earmarked for AI chip purchases without straining the balance sheet. This innovative financing solves a key pain point in tech's AI arms race—securing compute power without hurting credit ratings. The rare scale signals a shift from equity to structured debt for AI infrastructure, offering a bellwether for tech financing and bond markets.

items.title_cn: 感恩节晚餐正转向餐厅：高物价与烹饪压力推动外出就餐潮
items.title_en: Thanksgiving Dinner Is Moving to Restaurants
items.summary_cn: 彭博社美食编辑Kate Krader指出，由于食品杂货成本上涨、烹饪压力与清洁负担，越来越多美国人选择在餐厅享用感恩节晚餐。餐厅纷纷推出传统盛宴与创意菜单以迎合需求，感恩节预订量持续上升。这一消费行为转变不仅折射出通胀对家庭预算的挤压，也揭示了餐饮业在节日经济中的新机遇，值得关注其对消费趋势与行业格局的深层影响。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg Pursuits Food Editor Kate Krader notes that more Americans are choosing restaurants for Thanksgiving dinner, driven by higher grocery costs, cooking stress, and cleanup burdens. Restaurants are responding with traditional feasts and unconventional menus as reservations continue to rise. This shift in consumer behavior not only reflects inflation's squeeze on household budgets but also reveals new opportunities for the restaurant industry in the holiday economy, offering insights into deeper implications for consumption trends and industry dynamics.

items.title_cn: 1982年战争阴影未散：黎巴嫩如何塑造中东今日格局
items.title_en: The 1982 War Still Haunts the Middle East
items.summary_cn: 记者兼作家Kim Ghattas在彭博《This Weekend》节目中指出，1982年席卷黎巴嫩的暴力将美国、以色列、伊朗及整个中东推入一条持续影响至今的轨迹。结合新书《The Best Kind of American》，她剖析真主党的持久影响力、黎巴嫩重建国家权威的困境，以及以战争重塑地区秩序的风险。本文值得一读，因为它从历史根源切入，揭示了当前中东多重冲突背后被忽视的因果链条，为理解地区局势提供了关键的历史纵深。
items.summary_en: Journalist and author Kim Ghattas tells Bloomberg This Weekend how the violence that engulfed Lebanon in 1982 set the US, Israel, Iran and the wider Middle East on a trajectory that still shapes regional conflicts today. Discussing her new book The Best Kind of American, she examines Hezbollah's enduring influence, Lebanon's struggle to assert state authority, and the risks of trying to remake the region through war. This is worth reading because it traces current Middle East conflicts back to their historical roots, offering crucial historical depth for understanding the region's present dynamics.

items.title_cn: Alice Huang与芯片地下世界的关联
items.title_en: Alice Huang’s links to the chip underworld
items.summary_cn: 本文揭露了与前英伟达CEO黄仁勋有恋爱关系的中国高管Alice Huang，与利润丰厚的对华芯片走私贸易存在关联。报道深入调查了芯片地下产业链的运作方式，以及高层人脉如何可能被用于规避出口管制。这一事件不仅涉及个人关系与商业伦理，更触及中美科技竞争的核心敏感地带，值得关注芯片供应链安全与地缘政治风险的读者深入阅读。
items.summary_en: This article reveals that Alice Huang, a Chinese executive in a romantic relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, had connections to the lucrative trade of smuggling chips to China. The report investigates the chip underworld and how high-level connections may be exploited to circumvent export controls. Beyond personal relationships and business ethics, this story touches on the core sensitivities of US-China tech competition, making it essential reading for those concerned with chip supply chain security and geopolitical risks.

items.title_cn: 英伟达事件将中国间谍置于聚光灯下
items.title_en: Nvidia affair puts Chinese spies in spotlight
items.summary_cn: 西方官员和分析人士称，中国国家安全部在规模和技术能力上令人敬畏。英伟达事件引发对中国间谍活动的关注，凸显了中美科技竞争背景下情报活动的复杂性。该报道值得关注，因为它揭示了西方对中国情报能力的评估，以及科技企业在地缘政治博弈中面临的潜在风险。
items.summary_en: Western officials and analysts say China's Ministry of State Security is formidable in scale and technological capability. The Nvidia affair has drawn attention to Chinese espionage, highlighting the complexity of intelligence activities amid US-China tech rivalry. This report is worth reading as it reveals Western assessments of China's intelligence capabilities and the potential risks tech companies face in geopolitical competition.

items.title_cn: AI网络威胁已然降临
items.title_en: The AI cyber threat is already here
items.summary_cn: 文章以“冰箱战争”为引，揭示AI驱动的网络攻击已从科幻走入现实。值得看的是，它并非渲染恐慌，而是指出威胁的日常化与隐蔽性——智能设备、基础设施乃至家用电器都可能成为攻击载体。作者警示，传统安全思维已滞后，企业需重新评估AI在攻防两端的双重角色，并警惕低烈度、高频次的AI攻击如何累积成系统性风险。
items.summary_en: Using the 'freezer war' as a hook, the article reveals that AI-driven cyberattacks have moved from science fiction to reality. What makes it worth reading is that it avoids alarmism and instead highlights the everyday, covert nature of the threat—smart devices, infrastructure, and even home appliances can become attack vectors. The author warns that traditional security thinking is outdated, urging businesses to reassess AI's dual role in offense and defense, and to watch how low-intensity, high-frequency AI attacks accumulate into systemic risk.

items.title_cn: 历史的阴影笼罩德意志银行
items.title_en: The dead hand of history weighs on Deutsche Bank
items.summary_cn: 本文提醒银行家，决策具有长期后果。德意志银行正被历史包袱拖累，过往决策的阴影挥之不去。文章剖析了历史如何成为这家德国金融巨头的沉重负担，值得金融从业者与关注银行业的人士一读。
items.summary_en: This article reminds bankers that decisions have long-lasting consequences. Deutsche Bank is being dragged down by the weight of history, with the shadow of past decisions lingering. It analyzes how history has become a heavy burden for this German financial giant, making it a worthwhile read for finance professionals and those following the banking sector.

items.title_cn: 新词的制造：停滞社会为何热衷为旧事物重新命名
items.title_en: The manufacturing of novelty
items.summary_cn: 本文剖析当代社会一种耐人寻味的文化症候：多边恋、有效利他主义、需求回避等新词层出不穷，看似观念创新，实则多为旧有事物换上了新标签。作者指出，这种“新词制造”并非思想活力的体现，而恰恰是社会停滞的征兆——当实质变革乏力时，人们便转向语言层面的翻新，以命名的快感替代真正的进步。文章视角犀利，提醒读者警惕话语泡沫背后的创新匮乏，值得所有关注社会思潮与公共话语的人一读。
items.summary_en: This article examines a telling cultural symptom of our time: the proliferation of new terms such as polyamory, effective altruism, and demand avoidance, which often turn out to be old things dressed in new labels. The author argues that this 'manufacturing of novelty' is not a sign of intellectual vitality but rather of social stagnation—when substantive change stalls, people turn to linguistic reinvention, substituting the thrill of naming for genuine progress. Sharp and thought-provoking, the piece warns readers against the poverty of innovation hidden behind discursive froth, and merits attention from anyone concerned with social thought and public discourse.

items.title_cn: 亚马逊拟以75亿美元收购AI初创公司Decart，AWS加码算力竞赛挑战英伟达
items.title_en: Amazon closes in on $7.5bn deal to buy AI start-up Decart
items.summary_cn: 亚马逊即将以75亿美元收购AI芯片初创公司Decart，此举旨在强化AWS的算力基础设施，直接挑战英伟达在AI计算领域的主导地位。Decart的技术可能帮助AWS降低对英伟达GPU的依赖，提升云服务性价比。交易若达成，将重塑AI算力市场格局，值得关注其对云厂商竞争、芯片供应链及AI初创估值的影响。
items.summary_en: Amazon is nearing a $7.5bn deal to acquire AI chip start-up Decart, a move aimed at strengthening AWS's computing infrastructure and directly challenging Nvidia's dominance in AI computing. Decart's technology could help AWS reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs and improve cloud service cost-effectiveness. If completed, the deal would reshape the AI computing market, with implications for cloud competition, chip supply chains, and AI start-up valuations.

items.title_cn: 海军预算提名人选家族投资涉特朗普 Jr. 关联承包商
items.title_en: Navy budget pick has family investments in Trump Jr-linked contractor
items.summary_cn: 民主党人承诺在接管国会后，将就政府官员涉嫌利益冲突的问题展开追究。此事件涉及海军预算提名人选，其家族投资与特朗普 Jr. 有关联的承包商，可能成为民主党攻击的焦点。值得关注，因为它揭示了潜在的利益冲突，可能影响预算决策和国家安全，并加剧政治斗争。
items.summary_en: Democrats have promised to raise alleged conflicts of interest concerning administration officials when they take over Congress. This incident involves a Navy budget nominee whose family investments are linked to a contractor tied to Trump Jr., potentially becoming a focus of Democratic attacks. It is worth watching as it reveals potential conflicts of interest that could affect budget decisions and national security, and intensify political battles.

items.title_cn: 墨西哥大毒枭“矮子伊西德罗”落网 锡那罗亚州爆发暴力冲突
items.title_en: Violence erupts in Sinaloa after Mexico captures alleged drug trafficker
items.summary_cn: 墨西哥当局逮捕了绰号“矮子伊西德罗”的毒枭福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨-弗洛雷斯，此人因向美国走私毒品被列入FBI头号通缉名单。抓捕行动立即在锡那罗亚州引发暴力骚乱，凸显墨西哥政府在打击贩毒集团时面临的治安反噬风险。此次事件不仅关乎美墨禁毒合作成效，更考验当地民众安全与地区稳定，值得密切关注后续局势发展。
items.summary_en: Mexican authorities have captured drug trafficker Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores, known as "El Chapo Isidro," who is on the FBI's most-wanted list for trafficking drugs into the US. The arrest immediately triggered violence and unrest in Sinaloa, highlighting the security backlash risks Mexico faces when striking drug cartels. The incident bears on the effectiveness of US-Mexico counter-narcotics cooperation and tests local safety and regional stability, warranting close attention to further developments.

items.title_cn: Signal限制移动端截图功能，以应对AI监控的‘生存威胁’
items.title_en: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
items.summary_cn: 加密通讯应用Signal在Android和iOS端限制截图功能，直接回应AI监控带来的“生存威胁”。此举旨在防止用户对话被自动化系统批量捕获与分析，凸显隐私工具在AI时代面临的根本性挑战：当截图成为数据泄露入口，端到端加密的承诺需延伸至屏幕层面。值得关注的是，这标志着隐私保护从传输安全转向交互安全，可能引发行业对AI监控防御的连锁反应。
items.summary_en: Encrypted messaging app Signal is restricting screenshot functionality on Android and iOS, directly addressing the 'existential threat' posed by AI surveillance. The move aims to prevent user conversations from being captured and analyzed at scale by automated systems, highlighting a fundamental challenge for privacy tools in the AI era: when screenshots become a data leakage vector, the promise of end-to-end encryption must extend to the screen level. Notably, this marks a shift from transmission security to interaction security in privacy protection and could trigger industry-wide chain reactions against AI surveillance.

items.title_cn: 两个英伟达：财报与科技高管呼吁黄仁勋回归的迥异图景
items.title_en: A tale of two Nvidias
items.summary_cn: 本文揭示了英伟达的两副面孔：最新财报展现的业绩与科技高管公开呼吁黄仁勋回归形成鲜明对比。为何值得看？因为它凸显了市场对英伟达领导层与战略方向的深层分歧——财报数字或许亮眼，但行业内部对黄仁勋的呼声暗示了对其远见与执行力的迫切需求，折射出AI芯片巨头在高速增长背后的治理与战略张力。
items.summary_en: This article reveals two contrasting faces of Nvidia: its latest earnings report versus tech executives publicly calling for Jensen Huang's return. Why it matters: it highlights a deep divide over Nvidia's leadership and strategic direction—the financials may look strong, but the industry's call for Huang underscores an urgent need for his vision and execution, reflecting governance and strategic tensions behind the AI chip giant's rapid growth.

items.title_cn: 值得关注的短信AI助手：从通用助理到家庭、旅行与工作专用代理
items.title_en: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
items.summary_cn: 本文盘点了一批可直接在短信中运行的AI代理，涵盖通用助手、家庭管理、旅行规划和工作协同等场景。其价值在于揭示了AI交互正从独立App向原生通信渠道迁移的趋势：用户无需打开新界面，即可在熟悉的短信对话中完成任务。这降低了使用门槛，也预示着未来AI代理将更深度嵌入日常沟通流，成为随身的智能层。
items.summary_en: This article rounds up notable AI agents that operate directly within text messages, spanning general assistants, family management, travel planning, and work collaboration. Its value lies in highlighting a shift in AI interaction from standalone apps to native communication channels: users can complete tasks within familiar SMS threads without opening new interfaces. This lowers the barrier to use and signals that AI agents will become more deeply embedded in daily communication flows as a pervasive intelligence layer.

items.title_cn: 演员把脸卖给微短剧公司：好莱坞的未来趋势？
items.title_en: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
items.summary_cn: 一名演员将自己的面部授权给微短剧初创公司，这一在中国已流行的模式正试探好莱坞。文章探讨了AI面容授权对演员职业、肖像权及行业生态的长期影响，值得关注的是：当表演被数字化复制，创意与伦理的边界将如何重塑。
items.summary_en: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup, a model already popular in China that is now testing Hollywood. The article examines the long-term impact of AI face licensing on actors' careers,肖像 rights, and the industry ecosystem. It is worth watching how the boundaries of creativity and ethics will be reshaped when performance becomes digitally replicable.

items.title_cn: Daniel Ek 投资 AI 研究员创立的聚变能源初创公司 Europa Fusion，他们正在建造什么？
items.title_en: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
items.summary_cn: Spotify 创始人 Daniel Ek 投资了由 AI 研究员创立的聚变能源初创公司 Europa Fusion。该公司的独特之处在于将人工智能技术应用于聚变反应堆的控制与优化，有望加速实现可控核聚变这一清洁能源的终极目标。值得关注的是，这是科技资本与前沿 AI 研究在能源领域的跨界融合，可能为聚变商业化带来新路径。
items.summary_en: Spotify founder Daniel Ek has backed Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. The company's distinction lies in applying artificial intelligence to control and optimize fusion reactors, potentially accelerating the pursuit of controlled fusion as the ultimate clean energy source. This cross-sector convergence of tech capital and cutting-edge AI research in energy is noteworthy and may open new pathways for fusion commercialization.

items.title_cn: AI宣称解决167年历史的黎曼猜想，人类也同时宣布破解
items.title_en: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
items.summary_cn: 数学界被最新AI成果震撼：AI宣称攻克了167年未解的黎曼猜想，而几乎同时，人类数学家也提交了竞争性证明。这一双重突破不仅挑战了千禧年大奖难题的认知边界，更引发对AI与人类智慧协作与竞争的深层思考。无论最终验证结果如何，此事已标志AI在纯数学领域迈出历史性一步，值得密切关注其后续严格审查。
items.summary_en: The mathematics community is stunned by the latest AI-driven result: an AI claims to have solved the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, while almost simultaneously a human mathematician submitted a competing proof. This dual breakthrough not only challenges the boundaries of a Millennium Prize Problem but also sparks deep reflection on collaboration and competition between AI and human intelligence. Regardless of final verification, this marks a historic step for AI in pure mathematics and warrants close attention to the rigorous review that follows.

items.title_cn: 芯片能扛住太空环境，但融资能扛住吗？
items.title_en: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?
items.summary_cn: 太空数据中心被视为AI算力的下一个前沿，但融资端出现了一个被忽视的障碍：贷款机构不愿让SpaceX把抵押品射入轨道。本文从抵押品风险的角度切入，揭示了太空算力热潮背后金融逻辑的脆弱性——硬件能承受辐射与真空，却未必能承受资产负债表上的不确定性。对于关注AI基础设施、航天经济与项目融资的读者，这是一个值得警惕的信号：技术可行性不等于商业可行性，太空数据中心的规模化可能卡在融资结构而非工程能力上。
items.summary_en: Space data centers are touted as the next frontier for AI compute, but a overlooked obstacle is emerging on the financing side: lenders are reluctant to let SpaceX shoot their collateral into orbit. By examining collateral risk, this piece reveals the fragility of the financial logic behind the space-computing boom—hardware may withstand radiation and vacuum, but not necessarily balance-sheet uncertainty. For readers tracking AI infrastructure, the space economy, and project finance, this is a warning signal: technical feasibility does not equal commercial viability, and the scaling of space data centers may stall on financing structures rather than engineering capability.

items.title_cn: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋风波持续发酵：财报亮眼却停止对华销售H200芯片
items.title_en: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
items.summary_cn: 英伟达在CEO黄仁勋离职风波中发布最新财报，业绩增长健康并承诺好景延续，但同时宣布停止在中国销售H200芯片，并驳回了相关呼吁。这一矛盾动态揭示了地缘政治压力下芯片巨头的战略困境，值得关注其如何平衡商业利益与监管合规。
items.summary_en: Nvidia released its latest earnings report amid the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's ouster, showing healthy growth and promises of continued good times. However, the chipmaker also announced it will stop selling its H200 chips in China and dismissed related calls. This contradictory dynamic highlights the strategic dilemma of the chip giant under geopolitical pressure, making it worth watching how it balances commercial interests with regulatory compliance.

items.title_cn: AI领域最被误解的图表迎来重大更新：能力指数级增长，但判断力任务仍存短板
items.title_en: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.summary_cn: METR更新了其广受误解的AI能力时间跨度图，新增更长期和开放式任务。报告显示，AI在可验证任务（如编程、数学）上持续指数级进步，能力每四个月翻倍，但在需要判断力的任务上表现相对较弱。这揭示了当前AI发展的关键问题：自动验证领域的进步能否迁移到难以量化的任务？该图表及其更新对理解AI真实能力边界具有重要参考价值，值得深入解读。
items.summary_en: METR has updated its widely misunderstood AI capability time-horizon plot, adding longer and more open-ended tasks. The report shows that AI continues exponential progress on verifiable tasks like coding and math, with capabilities doubling every four months, but models are relatively weaker on tasks requiring judgment. This highlights a key question in AI: whether progress on automatically verifiable tasks transfers to harder-to-measure domains. The updated plot is valuable for understanding the true boundaries of AI capabilities and deserves careful interpretation.

items.title_cn: 追求意识永生：当科学家试图让大脑超越死亡
items.title_en: The Download: inside the quest to make our minds immortal
items.summary_cn: 本文探讨了科学家为实现“认知永生”而进行的各种尝试，从头移植、大脑冷冻到意识软件化身。MIT科技评论编辑在追踪资金、科学与哲学后，既怀疑又惊叹。文章揭示了美国政府1.9亿美元脑组织替代项目实则暗藏永生野心，大语言模型正使AI人格克隆成为可能，而Nectome公司想在辅助死亡后12分钟内保存大脑的商业模式却难以推销。文章引发思考：我们究竟想保存什么？值得一看，因为它直面了科技与死亡的交锋。
items.summary_en: This article explores scientists' quest for 'cognitive immortality' through head transplants, brain freezing, and conscious software avatars. After following the money, science, and philosophy, MIT Technology Review editors came away part skeptical, part awestruck. It reveals that a $190 million US government program for replacement brain tissue is a fig leaf for the ambition of living forever, that large language models enable convincing AI mind clones, and that Nectome's business of preserving brains within 12 minutes of medically assisted death is a hard sell. It prompts reflection: what exactly are we trying to preserve? Worth reading as it confronts the intersection of technology and death.

items.title_cn: The Download：活体肝脏体外存活七周、十亿美元电池交易与AI炒作
items.title_en: The Download: a living liver, a billion-dollar battery deal, and AI hype
items.summary_cn: 本期The Download聚焦三项科技进展：澳大利亚团队将人类肝脏在体外存活七周，打破此前两周纪录，为器官修复与再生开辟新可能；Sila与松下达成超十亿美元硅碳负极材料供应协议，为美国下一代电池市场注入信心；此外还涉及AI炒作话题。内容涵盖生物医学工程、能源存储与人工智能三大前沿领域，值得关注技术突破与产业动向的读者阅读。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download highlights three tech developments: Australian researchers kept a human liver alive outside the body for seven weeks, smashing the previous two-week record and opening new possibilities for organ repair and regeneration; Sila signed a deal worth over $1 billion with Panasonic Energy to supply silicon-carbon anode material, boosting confidence in the US next-generation battery market; and AI hype is also discussed. Covering biomedical engineering, energy storage, and artificial intelligence, it is worth reading for those tracking technological breakthroughs and industry trends.

items.title_cn: 人类肝脏在体外存活七周，创下新纪录
items.title_en: A human liver has been kept alive outside the body for a record seven weeks
items.summary_cn: 澳大利亚研究团队利用自动化泵和传感器系统，在体外将捐赠人类肝脏以常温生理条件维持存活长达七周，打破此前两周的纪录。这项名为“扩展器官灌注系统”的技术模拟人工身体，持续供给营养、血液并清除废物。该突破有望延长器官保存时间，为移植医学和生物医学工程开辟新可能，但细节尚待发表。
items.summary_en: An Australian research team kept a donated human liver alive outside the body for seven weeks under fully normothermic physiological conditions using an automated pump and sensor system, breaking the previous two-week record. The technology, called the Extended Organ Perfusion System, mimics an artificial body by supplying nutrients and blood while removing waste. This breakthrough could extend organ preservation times and open new possibilities in transplant medicine and biomedical engineering, though details are pending publication.

items.title_cn: 十亿美元大单背后：美国电池市场的政治与产业变局
items.title_en: What a billion-dollar deal says about the US battery market
items.summary_cn: Sila与松下能源签署超10亿美元硅碳负极材料供应协议，被视为美国下一代电池产业的积极信号。值得关注的是，该工厂生产资金主要来自特朗普政府国防部14亿美元贷款，凸显电池产业重心已从气候减排转向地缘政治竞争。Sila的硅基负极重量仅为石墨的五分之一、体积减半，可显著提升能量密度，使电动车续航更长、充电更快。这一交易不仅反映技术突破，更揭示了美国电池产业政策逻辑的深刻转变。
items.summary_en: Sila has signed a deal worth over $1 billion with Panasonic Energy to supply silicon-carbon anode material, a positive signal for the US next-generation battery industry after years of high-profile failures. Notably, the factory's production is largely financed by a $1.4 billion loan from the Trump administration's Defense Department, highlighting how the battery industry's focus has shifted from energy transition and emissions reduction to geopolitics. Sila's silicon-based anode weighs one-fifth as much as graphite and halves the volume, enabling higher energy density, longer EV range, and faster charging. The deal reveals not only a technological breakthrough but also a profound shift in the policy logic of the US battery industry.

items.title_cn: AI炒作指数：AI无处不在
items.title_en: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
items.summary_cn: 本文以讽刺笔调描绘AI已如皮疹般蔓延至生活每个角落：谷歌强推AI概览却损失数十亿广告收入，人形机器人上楼打扫，AI网络攻击导致超市地面融化冰淇淋，奥特曼被拍成电影、马斯克推出Grok版《奥德赛》。作者将当代人比作现代奥德修斯，在AI泛滥的水域中与机器神魔搏斗，寻找回家的路。文章以鲜活场景揭示了AI狂热背后的荒诞与代价，值得一读。
items.summary_en: This satirical piece depicts AI as a rash spreading into every corner of life: Google pushes AI Overviews while losing billions in ad revenue, humanoid robots haul themselves upstairs to clean apartments, AI-assisted cyberattacks leave melted ice cream pooling on supermarket floors, Sam Altman gets a biopic, and Musk releases a Grok-fied Odyssey. The author likens modern people to a new Odysseus, roaming AI-infested waters, dueling machine gods and monsters, trying to find the way home. Vivid scenes expose the absurdity and costs behind AI hype—a worthwhile read.

items.title_cn: AI学会嗅觉，美国西南部水电陷入困境
items.title_en: The Download: AI learns to smell and hydropower struggles
items.summary_cn: 本期The Download聚焦两项技术进展：新泽西初创公司Osmo声称其AI鼻子已达到人类嗅觉水平，正帮助香氛品牌设计新气味，并计划拓展至防伪和疾病诊断领域；与此同时，美国西南部今夏水电发电量较十年均值下降28%，凸显气候变化对能源供应的冲击。值得关注的是，AI嗅觉基础模型能否真正兑现承诺仍存争议，而水电短缺则直接反映气候风险对电网的現實压力。
items.summary_en: This edition of The Download highlights two technology developments: New Jersey startup Osmo claims its AI nose has achieved human-level olfactory intelligence and is helping fragrance brands design new scents, with ambitions extending to counterfeit detection and disease diagnosis; meanwhile, the US Southwest generated 28% less hydropower this summer than the 10-year average, underscoring climate change's impact on energy supply. Notably, whether AI smell foundation models can deliver on their promises remains debated, while the hydropower shortfall directly reflects climate risks putting real pressure on the grid.

items.title_cn: 这家气味初创公司称其AI嗅觉媲美人类
items.title_en: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human's
items.summary_cn: Osmo公司利用30名专业嗅辨员标注的气味数据，训练出号称全球首个气味基础模型，并宣称其已达到“人类水平嗅觉智能”——在辨别气味上媲美普通人，在创香上接近初级调香师。该技术已在香精行业应用，并在一家全球最大消费品公司内部测试中击败调香师。创始人来自Google Brain，其“大数据+难问题”的思路若成功，未来或可用于机场安检和疾病诊断，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Osmo has trained what it calls the world's first foundation model for smell using data labeled by 30 expert sniffers, and claims it has reached 'human-level olfactory intelligence'—matching an average person at detecting and discriminating odors and a junior perfumer at creating them. The tech is already used in the fragrance industry and reportedly outperformed in-house perfumers at one of the world's largest consumer goods companies. Founded by an ex-Google Brain researcher, the data-heavy approach could eventually enable airport threat detection and disease diagnosis, making it worth watching.

items.title_cn: 联合国未能就“杀手机器人”监管规则达成一致
items.title_en: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
items.summary_cn: 联合国在日内瓦召开的会议上，各国代表就自主武器系统（即“杀手机器人”）的监管规则展开讨论，但经过一周谈判仍未取得实质进展，最终仅同意“开始讨论选项”。红十字国际委员会、联合国秘书长及教皇利奥曾呼吁一年内制定具有法律约束力的规则，但未能实现。这一僵局意味着致命性自主武器的国际管控仍遥遥无期，值得关注其后续对全球安全与伦理的影响。
items.summary_en: At a UN meeting in Geneva, diplomats discussed regulations for autonomous weapons systems, or 'killer robots,' but after a week of negotiations made little progress, agreeing only to 'start discussing options.' The International Committee of the Red Cross, the UN Secretary-General, and Pope Leo had urged legally binding rules within a year, but this was not achieved. The deadlock means international control over lethal autonomous weapons remains distant, making it a critical issue for global security and ethics.

items.title_cn: Anthropic上市后还能坚持安全优先吗？
items.title_en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
items.summary_cn: Anthropic登陆纳斯达克成为全球最有价值公司之一，但真正的考验才刚开始：如何在取悦股东、支付未来数年约9000亿美元算力账单的同时，继续兑现AI安全承诺。本文对话The Verge资深AI记者Hayden Field，拆解其独特公司治理结构在黄仁勋事件余波下的意义，以及OpenAI等竞争对手的对照，揭示公共利益与资本压力之间的深层张力，值得关注AI治理走向的读者一读。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has gone public on Nasdaq, becoming one of the most valuable companies on the planet—but the real story is what happens next. This conversation with The Verge senior AI reporter Hayden Field examines whether Anthropic can keep investing in AI safety while satisfying shareholders and funding roughly $900 billion in future compute bills. It breaks down the company's unique corporate governance structure, especially relevant after the ongoing Jensen Huang saga, and contrasts it with OpenAI, offering a sharp look at the tension between public-interest commitments and market pressures.

items.title_cn: Chess.com 下一步：打造经典游戏中心，涵盖麻将、数独等十款游戏
items.title_en: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
items.summary_cn: Chess.com 不再满足于国际象棋，推出 Classic Games 平台，新增麻将、数独、围棋、双陆棋等十款经典游戏，并发布网页版及 iOS/Android 应用公测。此举旨在将线下社交游戏体验线上化，满足用户对多元化棋牌游戏的需求，标志着 Chess.com 从单一棋类平台向综合游戏社区的转型，值得关注其能否复制国际象棋的成功模式。
items.summary_en: Chess.com is expanding beyond chess with its new Classic Games platform, adding ten classic games including mahjong, sudoku, go, and backgammon, launching a public beta on web, iOS, and Android. The move aims to bring offline social gaming experiences online and meet user demand for diverse board and card games, marking Chess.com's transition from a single-game platform to a comprehensive gaming community. It's worth watching whether it can replicate its chess success.

items.title_cn: 特朗普威胁对在美境外建AI数据中心征收“巨额税”
items.title_en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary_cn: 特朗普在中美俄峰会后的记者会上表示，将对在境外建设数据中心的美国公司征收“巨额税”，并称不会允许企业将数据中心建在国外，理由是芯片等产业外流曾损害美国。此举与多州和城市限制数据中心新建申请的现状形成对比，凸显AI基础设施正成为产业政策与地缘竞争焦点。该表态若落地，将影响科技巨头全球算力布局与成本结构，值得关注后续政策细节。
items.summary_en: At a press conference following his summit with the Chinese and Russian presidents, Trump said he would impose a 'tremendous tax' on US companies that build data centers abroad, vowing not to let them move such facilities outside the country, arguing that offshoring chips and other industries had harmed the US. The threat contrasts with state and local restrictions on new data center applications and highlights AI infrastructure as a focus of industrial policy and geopolitical competition. If implemented, it could affect tech giants' global compute footprint and cost structures, making follow-up policy details worth watching.

items.title_cn: Anthropic数学家声称借助Claude解决了千禧年大奖难题中的黎曼猜想
items.title_en: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary_cn: Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge声称借助Claude证明了黎曼猜想——一个困扰顶尖数学家数十年的千禧年大奖难题。若经独立验证，这将是AI在数学领域的又一地震级成就，继OpenAI此前的突破后进一步颠覆该领域。目前该证明尚未被独立验证，Anthropic未予置评。Alpöge称曾就此发短信给CEO Dario Amodei。此事值得关注，因为它可能标志着AI辅助数学证明进入新阶段，同时也引发关于验证机制与AI贡献度的讨论。
items.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis, a Millennium Prize Problem that has eluded top mathematicians for decades, with the help of Claude. If verified, it would mark another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics, following OpenAI's previous breakthroughs. The proof has not yet been independently verified, and Anthropic has not commented. Alpöge says he texted CEO Dario Amodei about it. This is worth watching as it may signal a new phase in AI-assisted mathematical proof, while raising questions about verification and the extent of AI's contribution.

items.title_cn: 当科技世界集体崩塌的一周：从Outlook瘫痪到全国停飞
items.title_en: The week everything fell apart
items.summary_cn: 本周科技界遭遇连环故障：Outlook数日宕机、FAA全国停飞（25年来第二次）、银行系统突然失灵、iCloud也未能幸免。The Vergecast深入拆解每起事件——真相远比阴谋论温和，但为何这些看似独立的小故障叠加起来，仍值得警惕？本文帮你厘清事实，理解系统性风险的真正信号。
items.summary_en: This week saw a cascade of tech failures: a dayslong Outlook outage, only the second nationwide FAA ground stop in 25 years, banks suddenly going down, and even iCloud faltering. The Vergecast breaks down each incident—generally milder than conspiracy theories suggest—and explains why these seemingly isolated glitches may still add up to something worth worrying about. A clear-eyed look at the real signals of systemic risk.

items.title_cn: Signal 阻止 Gemini 和 Siri 读取你的屏幕内容
items.title_en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
items.summary_cn: Signal 在 Android 和 iOS 上限制截图功能，以阻止系统级 AI 代理读取用户消息和屏幕数据。Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 指出，操作系统内置的代理式 AI 分析屏幕信息的行为正在破坏 Signal 独立保障隐私的能力，并呼吁 OS 厂商为开发者提供控制 AI 代理数据访问的工具。这凸显了端侧 AI 与隐私保护之间的根本冲突，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to prevent OS-level AI agents from reading users' messages and on-screen data. Signal president Meredith Whittaker said agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems are undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy, and urged OS providers to give developers robust tools to control what data AI agents can access. This highlights the fundamental conflict between on-device AI and privacy protection.

items.title_cn: 苹果招聘工程师自研AI智能体，剑指跨应用任务自动化
items.title_en: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
items.summary_cn: 苹果正招聘高级工程经理，领导开发能浏览网页、跨应用操作、写代码和调用服务的自研AI智能体。此举意味着苹果正式加入Meta Muse、OpenAI Dots、Anthropic Duet和Google Tasks的智能体竞赛，而竞争对手已通过Mac应用实现电脑控制。苹果凭借iPhone生态和端侧优势，有望将智能体深度集成到系统层，重塑用户与设备的交互方式，值得关注其如何后来居上。
items.summary_en: Apple is hiring a senior engineering manager to lead the creation of an in-house AI agent capable of browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. This move officially enters Apple into the agentic AI race alongside Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots, Anthropic's Duet, and Google's Tasks, some of which already control computers via Mac apps. With its iPhone ecosystem and on-device strengths, Apple could deeply integrate the agent into the OS and reshape user-device interaction, making its late-mover strategy worth watching.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯：一份赏析
items.title_en: Martin Amis: An Appreciation
items.summary_cn: 本文是对英国作家马丁·艾米斯（1949-2023）的致敬与赏析。文章以2007年的一次相遇为引，回顾了艾米斯作为“伦敦三部曲”作者、语言革新者与公共知识分子的独特地位。作者指出，艾米斯以凌厉的讽刺、对道德困境的执着探索以及对当代资本主义的尖锐批判，延续了英国小说中斯威夫特式的传统。他的作品如《金钱》《伦敦场地》等，不仅记录了撒切尔时代的文化症候，更以极致的文体意识拓展了小说的表现力。这篇赏析之所以值得阅读，在于它既是对一位文学巨匠的深情告别，也为我们理解艾米斯如何以文字对抗时代虚无提供了精炼的入口。
items.summary_en: This is a tribute to and appreciation of the British writer Martin Amis (1949–2023). Opening with an encounter in 2007, the piece revisits Amis's singular position as the author of the "London Trilogy," a linguistic innovator, and a public intellectual. The author argues that Amis, through his savage satire, his obsession with moral dilemmas, and his sharp critique of contemporary capitalism, extends the Swiftian tradition in English fiction. Works such as Money and London Fields not only chronicle the cultural symptoms of the Thatcher era but also expand the novel's expressive range through an extreme stylistic self-consciousness. This appreciation is worth reading because it is both a heartfelt farewell to a literary giant and a concise entry point for understanding how Amis used language to confront the nihilism of his age.

items.title_cn: 书评：《NB by J.C.》，詹姆斯·坎贝尔著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘NB by J.C.,’ by James Campbell
items.summary_cn: 詹姆斯·坎贝尔的《NB by J.C.》汇集了他在《泰晤士报文学增刊》上撰写的多彩随笔。这些文字兼具博学与机锋，涉猎文学、文化与人情世故，展现了一位资深评论家的敏锐洞察与独特文风。本书值得一读，因为它不仅是对文坛轶事的生动记录，更是一场与智者对话的愉悦旅程，让读者在轻松阅读中收获对文学与生活的深刻理解。
items.summary_en: “NB by J.C.” collects the variegated musings of James Campbell in the Times Literary Supplement. These pieces combine erudition with wit, covering literature, culture, and human manners, and showcase a veteran critic’s sharp insight and distinctive style. The book is worth reading not only as a lively record of literary anecdotes but also as a delightful conversation with a wise mind, offering readers a deeper understanding of literature and life through effortless reading.

items.title_cn: 《黑暗中的火焰》：凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森转向疗愈者
items.title_en: In ‘Fires in the Dark,’ Kay Redfield Jamison Turns to Healers
items.summary_cn: 贾米森曾以自身精神疾病经历写作，收到读者反馈称其作品改变了他们的人生，但也遭遇大量退稿。在新书《黑暗中的火焰》中，她将目光转向疗愈者——那些帮助他人走出心理黑暗的人。本书结合个人叙事与对疗愈过程的深刻洞察，探讨治愈的本质、疗愈者的角色以及希望如何在绝望中点燃。对于关注心理健康、叙事医学与人性韧性的读者，这是一部不容错过的作品。
items.summary_en: Jamison, who wrote about her own experiences with mental illness, met people whose lives her writing had changed—but she also faced much rejection. In 'Fires in the Dark,' she turns to healers: those who help others emerge from psychological darkness. Blending personal narrative with deep insight into the healing process, the book explores the nature of cure, the role of healers, and how hope ignites amid despair. Essential reading for those interested in mental health, narrative medicine, and human resilience.

items.title_cn: 侦探小说《谁的尸体？》百年诞辰：多萝西·L·塞耶斯的开创性之作
items.title_en: The Detective Novel ‘Whose Body?,’ by Dorothy L. Sayers, Turns 100
items.summary_cn: 多萝西·L·塞耶斯1923年出版的《谁的尸体？》迎来百年诞辰。这部作品塑造了贵族侦探彼得·温西勋爵，并以其机智的文笔、对推理规则的尊重及对人性与社会的深刻观察，成为侦探小说黄金时代的里程碑。塞耶斯参与创立侦探俱乐部，推动了类型文学的严肃化。本书至今仍值得阅读，不仅因其精巧的谜题设计，更因为它展现了侦探小说如何承载道德思辨与时代精神，对后世作家影响深远。
items.summary_en: Dorothy L. Sayers's 'Whose Body?', published in 1923, turns 100. Introducing the aristocratic detective Lord Peter Wimsey, the novel is a milestone of the Golden Age of detective fiction, noted for its wit, adherence to fair-play rules, and insightful observations on human nature and society. Sayers helped found the Detection Club, elevating the genre's seriousness. The book remains worth reading not only for its clever puzzle but also for how it shows detective fiction carrying moral inquiry and the spirit of its time, influencing generations of writers.

items.title_cn: 书评：《堂卡斯穆罗》，马查多·德·阿西斯著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘Dom Casmurro,’ by Machado de Assis
items.summary_cn: 《堂卡斯穆罗》是巴西文学巨匠马查多·德·阿西斯的杰作，通过不可靠叙述者本托的回忆，讲述了一段因嫉妒而毁灭的爱情。本书教会我们以精确细节和精湛的模糊性去阅读与重读——真相始终悬而未决，读者被迫成为侦探。这部小说深刻揭示了人类自欺、记忆的欺骗性以及叙事本身的权力，是理解现代文学不确定性的必读经典。
items.summary_en: Dom Casmurro, a masterpiece by Brazilian literary giant Machado de Assis, tells a love story destroyed by jealousy through the unreliable narration of Bento. The book teaches us to read and reread with precise detail and masterly obfuscation—truth remains suspended, forcing the reader to become a detective. The novel profoundly explores human self-deception, the deceitfulness of memory, and the power of narrative itself, making it essential reading for understanding modern literary uncertainty.

items.title_cn: 书评：《晚来的人》，布兰登·泰勒著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘The Late Americans,’ by Brandon Taylor
items.summary_cn: 布兰登·泰勒的新作《晚来的人》以爱荷华城为背景，描绘了一群居民——有的享有特权，有的没有，但都意识到自己的可能性正在收缩。小说敏锐地捕捉了当代青年在阶级、欲望与艺术追求间的挣扎，笔触细腻而富有洞察力。泰勒延续了《真实生活》中对身份与关系的探索，将目光投向更广阔的社会图景。这部作品值得一读，因为它以精准的心理刻画和优雅的叙事，揭示了人们在有限选择中的生存状态，令人共鸣且深思。
items.summary_en: Brandon Taylor’s novel, ‘The Late Americans,’ circulates among Iowa City residents—some privileged, some not, but all aware that their possibilities are contracting. With keen observation and elegant prose, Taylor captures the struggles of contemporary young adults navigating class, desire, and artistic ambition. Continuing his exploration of identity and relationships from ‘Real Life,’ Taylor broadens his social canvas. This book is worth reading for its precise psychological portraiture and graceful storytelling, revealing how people live within constrained choices—resonant and thought-provoking.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯最佳书籍指南
items.title_en: Martin Amis’s Best Books: A Guide
items.summary_cn: 马丁·艾米斯共出版15部小说，以其机智与语言创造力广受赞誉。本指南梳理其最佳作品，帮助读者理解他如何以独特文体捕捉时代精神与人性暗面。对于想入门艾米斯或重读其经典的读者，这份指南提供了清晰脉络与选择依据，是探索这位英国文坛重要声音的实用参考。
items.summary_en: Martin Amis published 15 novels, acclaimed for their wit and linguistic ingenuity. This guide surveys his best books, helping readers understand how his distinctive style captures the zeitgeist and the darker sides of human nature. For those new to Amis or revisiting his classics, it offers a clear roadmap and rationale for selection—a practical reference for exploring this significant voice in British literature.

items.title_cn: 2024年最佳爱情小说（迄今）
items.title_en: The Best Romance Novels of 2024 (So Far)
items.summary_cn: 本文精选2024年迄今为止最性感、最令人心动的爱情小说，为寻求逃离现实的读者提供一份浪漫书单。这些作品不仅情节引人入胜，更以细腻的情感描写和强烈的化学反应脱颖而出，适合渴望沉浸于甜蜜与激情中的读者。无论是轻松消遣还是深度共鸣，这份榜单都能满足你对爱情小说的期待，值得一看。
items.summary_en: This article curates the sexiest and swooniest romance novels of 2024 so far, offering a romantic reading list for those seeking escapism. These works stand out not only for their engaging plots but also for their nuanced emotional writing and intense chemistry, perfect for readers craving sweetness and passion. Whether for light entertainment or deeper resonance, this list meets your expectations for romance novels and is worth checking out.

items.title_cn: 尼古丁对大脑与身体的影响及戒烟戒电子烟的科学方法
items.title_en: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.summary_cn: 本期Huberman Lab精要节目深入解析尼古丁如何通过提升多巴胺、乙酰胆碱和去甲肾上腺素来增强动力、专注力与警觉性，同时抑制食欲、升高心率和血压。节目区分了尼古丁本身与吸烟、电子烟等递送方式，揭示电子烟尤其易成瘾的原因及戒断困难背后的科学机制，并提供了临床催眠、处方药物、尼古丁替代等循证戒烟工具，以及如何度过戒断关键第一周的实用策略。对于想了解尼古丁真实作用或正在戒烟的人来说，这是一份兼具科学深度与实操价值的指南。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, the science of nicotine is unpacked—how it boosts dopamine, acetylcholine, and norepinephrine to enhance motivation, focus, and alertness while suppressing appetite and raising heart rate and blood pressure. The episode distinguishes nicotine itself from delivery methods like smoking, vaping, dipping, and snuffing, explains why vaping is especially habit-forming and why quitting is so hard, and offers science-based tools to quit, including clinical hypnosis, prescription medication, and nicotine replacement strategies, plus how to navigate the critical first week of withdrawal. A must-watch for anyone seeking a clear, evidence-based understanding of nicotine or looking to quit.

items.title_cn: 真菌如何重塑大脑与免疫系统：Paul Stamets 谈蘑菇的药用潜能
items.title_en: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.summary_cn: 本期节目邀请“现代应用真菌学之父”Paul Stamets，深入探讨真菌对人类健康的革命性影响。内容涵盖非致幻蘑菇如何提升认知与神经可塑性、蘑菇对免疫系统的调节机制，以及裸盖菇素在治疗抑郁、焦虑等精神疾病中的应用与安全考量。无论你是想了解真菌生物学，还是寻找改善身心健康的自然路径，这期对话都提供了前沿且实用的科学洞察。
items.summary_en: In this episode, Paul Stamets, widely regarded as the father of modern applied mycology, explores the revolutionary impact of fungi on human health. The discussion covers how non-psychedelic mushrooms can enhance cognition and neuroplasticity, how mushrooms modulate the immune system, and the use of psilocybin for depression, anxiety, and other mental health conditions, along with important safety considerations. Whether you want to understand fungal biology or seek natural pathways to improve mental and physical well-being, this conversation offers cutting-edge and practical scientific insights.

items.title_cn: 情绪与社会因素如何影响学习：与Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang对谈
items.title_en: Essentials: How Emotions & Social Factors Impact Learning | Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang
items.summary_cn: 本期Huberman Lab Essentials邀请南加州大学教育学与心理学教授Mary Helen Immordino-Yang，深入探讨情绪、故事与文化如何塑造我们的感知、学习与自我认同。她解释了叙事如何促进共情或导致非人化，并指出教育应重新设计以激发好奇心、意义建构与全人发展。内容兼具神经科学深度与教育实践启示，适合关注学习科学、情绪智力与教育创新的观众。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang, professor of education and psychology at USC, explores how emotions, stories, and culture shape perception, learning, and sense of self. She explains how narratives can foster empathy or dehumanization, and how education can be redesigned to engage curiosity, meaning-making, and whole-person development. Blending neuroscience depth with educational insights, this conversation is valuable for anyone interested in learning science, emotional intelligence, and educational innovation.

items.title_cn: 为什么成瘾是一个控制问题 | 安娜·伦布克博士
items.title_en: Why Addiction is a Control Problem | Dr. Anna Lembke
items.summary_cn: 斯坦福成瘾医学专家安娜·伦布克博士指出，成瘾与我们追求控制感、减少不确定性的本能密切相关。她深入解析了多巴胺、焦虑与羞耻感在成瘾行为中的作用机制，揭示了为何越试图控制越容易失控。这段视频从神经科学视角重新定义成瘾，帮助观众理解成瘾根源并找到更有效的应对策略，对于任何想了解行为成瘾、情绪调节或自我控制的人来说都极具启发。
items.summary_en: Dr. Anna Lembke, a leading addiction expert at Stanford, explains that addiction is closely tied to our innate desire to assert control and reduce uncertainty. She delves into the mechanisms of dopamine, anxiety, and shame in addictive behaviors, revealing why the more we try to control, the more we lose control. This video redefines addiction from a neuroscience perspective, helping viewers understand its roots and find more effective coping strategies. It is highly insightful for anyone interested in behavioral addiction, emotional regulation, or self-control.

items.title_cn: 打破共依赖循环：多巴胺、控制成瘾与彻底臣服 | 安娜·伦布克博士
items.title_en: Breaking the Codependency Cycle | Dr. Anna Lembke
items.summary_cn: 斯坦福成瘾医学专家安娜·伦布克博士深入解析多巴胺如何驱动冒险、执念与强迫行为，并揭示最常见的成瘾——对控制的成瘾。共依赖正是其典型表现。她提出看似悖论的“彻底臣服”：放弃控制执念反而能激活新神经通路，借助祈祷与灵性实践打破不健康的思维与行为模式。本书兼具科学性与可操作工具，值得每一个被控制欲或共依赖困扰的人观看。
items.summary_en: Dr. Anna Lembke, Stanford addiction medicine expert, explores how dopamine dynamics drive risk-taking, mental obsession, and compulsive behaviors, and reveals the most common addiction of all—addiction to control—with codependency as a key form. She presents the paradoxical 'radical surrender': giving up the attempt to control certain thoughts or behaviors actually opens new neural pathways and strategies, aided by prayer and spiritual practices, to end unhealthy patterns including codependence. Grounded in science and full of actionable tools, this is essential viewing for anyone struggling with control or codependency.

items.title_cn: 如何克服一切成瘾与执念 | 安娜·伦布克博士
items.title_en: Overcome Addictions and Obsessions of All Kinds | Dr. Anna Lembke
items.summary_cn: 斯坦福成瘾医学专家安娜·伦布克博士深入解析多巴胺机制如何驱动冒险、执念与强迫行为，并揭示最常见的成瘾——对控制的执念。她结合神经科学与灵性实践，探讨祈祷与精神修行如何开辟新神经通路，帮助打破不健康的思维模式与行为（包括共依赖）。无论你正与数字媒体成瘾、物质依赖还是控制欲作斗争，这期对话都提供了科学而深刻的疗愈路径，值得一看。
items.summary_en: Dr. Anna Lembke, a leading Stanford addiction expert, explains how dopamine dynamics drive risk-taking, mental obsession, and compulsive behaviors, and reveals the most common addiction of all—the addiction to control. She integrates neuroscience with spiritual practices, discussing how prayer and spiritual exercises can open new neural pathways to break unhealthy thought patterns and behaviors, including codependence. Whether you struggle with digital media addiction, substance dependence, or the need to control, this conversation offers a scientifically grounded and deeply insightful path to healing.

items.title_cn: 利用并行通路、运动与寒冷提升专注力与学习效率
items.title_en: LEVERAGING PARALLEL PATHWAYS, EXERCISE & COLD TO FOCUS & LEARN BETTER
items.summary_cn: 本文揭示运动与寒冷暴露如何通过并行通路提升专注与学习：中高强度运动提高警觉性，为学习创造窗口，但真正变聪明仍需主动学习与自我导向的神经可塑性；刻意寒冷暴露则激活外周肾上腺素、多巴胺和中枢去甲肾上腺素，甚至激活中脑边缘奖赏通路。理解这些儿茶酚胺的并行机制，能帮你科学调控压力阈值、精力与专注，值得所有追求高效学习与健康的人细读。
items.summary_en: This piece explains how exercise and deliberate cold exposure enhance focus and learning through parallel pathways: moderate-to-intense exercise boosts alertness, creating a window for learning, but getting smarter still requires active learning and self-directed neuroplasticity; deliberate cold exposure activates peripheral adrenaline, dopamine, and central norepinephrine, and may even engage mesolimbic reward pathways. Understanding how these catecholamines work in parallel helps you manage stress thresholds, energy, and focus—essential reading for anyone pursuing efficient learning and health.

items.title_cn: essentials：冷热暴露如何改善代谢健康 | Susanna Søberg博士
items.title_en: Essentials: Cold & Heat Exposure for Metabolic Health | Dr. Susanna Søberg
items.summary_cn: 本期Huberman Lab Essentials邀请代谢科学家Susanna Søberg博士，深入解析刻意冷暴露与热暴露对代谢健康的益处。她解释了短暂冷暴露如何提升胰岛素敏感性、促进代谢健康与生理韧性，并探讨冷休克反应、颤抖产热以及温度、时长和冷热顺序的实用方案。内容兼具科学深度与可操作性，适合关注代谢优化与健康韧性的观众。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, metabolic scientist Dr. Susanna Søberg explains how deliberate cold and heat exposure benefit metabolic health. She discusses how brief cold exposure improves insulin sensitivity, promotes metabolic health and physiological resilience, and covers the cold shock response, shivering, and practical guidance on temperature, duration, and sequencing. The episode blends scientific depth with actionable protocols, ideal for those interested in metabolic optimization and resilience.

items.title_cn: 一个AI提示词，帮你规划整个人生
items.title_en: This One AI Prompt Will Organise Your Entire Life
items.summary_cn: Ali Abdaal分享了他用来规划整个人生的一个AI提示词，将生产力、时间管理和目标设定的精华浓缩为五个步骤：绘制人生地图、定义季度任务、构建GPS导航、制定周计划蓝图、识别错位。这个提示词值得一看，因为它把复杂的自我管理框架转化为可执行的AI指令，让你借助人工智能系统性地梳理目标与行动，避免盲目忙碌，真正实现人生有序化。
items.summary_en: Ali Abdaal shares the one AI prompt he uses to organise his entire life, distilling the best of productivity, time management and goal-setting into five steps: map your life, define your quarterly quests, build your GPS, create your weekly blueprint and identify misalignment. This prompt is worth watching because it turns a complex self-management framework into an actionable AI instruction, letting you systematically align goals with actions and avoid busyness without direction.

items.title_cn: 如果你有工作，请立刻开始出售你的技能
items.title_en: If You Have a Job, Start Selling Your Skills ASAP
items.summary_cn: 大多数人靠工资收入，但工资是有上限的。本视频深入剖析了为什么死工资会封顶，并给出两条突破路径：一是将技能打包成能解决具体问题的产品，二是围绕人们愿意付费的痛点来变现。作者还提供了免费工作簿和8周实战大师课，帮助你在不辞职的情况下，把技能转化为独立收入。如果你有技能却只靠薪水，这期视频值得一看。
items.summary_en: Most people rely on a salary, but salaries have a ceiling. This video breaks down why fixed wages cap your income and offers two ways past it: packaging your skills around problems people will happily pay to solve, and monetizing those pain points. The creator also provides a free workbook and an 8-week masterclass to help you turn your skills into independent income without quitting your job. If you have skills but only earn a salary, this video is worth watching.

items.title_cn: 让观众开心的最佳方式之一：提供免费资源（含自动化工具推荐）
items.title_en: One of the best ways to make your audience happy is by providing free resources... #ad
items.summary_cn: 本视频指出，在Instagram上经营业务时，除了发布有用内容，还需引导感兴趣的用户迈出下一步——发送免费资源、询问反馈或推荐产品。手动发送数百条私信不现实，因此作者推荐使用Manychat自动化对话：用户评论关键词即可自动收到资源并跟进。视频还提供30天免费试用Manychat Pro的链接。值得一看，因为它提供了可落地的自动化增长策略，帮助创作者高效转化受众。
items.summary_en: This video explains that when building a business on Instagram, posting useful content is only part of the job—you also need to give interested people a way to take the next step, such as sending a free resource, asking for feedback, or pointing them to a relevant product. Manually sending hundreds of DMs isn't practical, so the creator recommends using Manychat to automate those conversations: when users comment a keyword, they automatically receive the resource and can be followed up with. A 30-day free trial link for Manychat Pro is provided. It's worth watching because it offers an actionable automation strategy to help creators efficiently convert their audience.

items.title_cn: 如何致富：我在商学院演讲中给创业新手的全部建议
items.title_en: How to Get Rich (My Talk at a Business School)
items.summary_cn: Ali Abdaal 在香港中文大学商学院的一场演讲，面向想第一次创业的学生和职场人。他从炉边谈话迅速转向白板，系统分享了自己如果今天从零开始会给出的全部建议：如何发现商业想法、如何低成本启动、如何把技能转化为独立收入，以及如何在不辞职的情况下用8周时间验证方向。视频还附带创作者工具、MBA替代课程和生产力系统的资源链接。适合想创业但不知从何下手、需要一套可操作路线图的人观看。
items.summary_en: In this talk at CUHK Business School in Hong Kong, Ali Abdaal addresses students and professionals who want to start their first business. Moving quickly from a fireside chat to the whiteboard, he lays out all the advice he would give someone starting today: how to find business ideas, launch with low overhead, turn skills into independent income, and validate a direction in eight weeks without quitting your job. The description also includes resources for creator tools, an MBA alternative, and a productivity system. Ideal for aspiring founders who need a practical, step-by-step roadmap.

items.title_cn: 我现在最常用的5款效率应用
items.title_en: My top 5 productivity apps right now
items.summary_cn: Ali Abdaal在这期视频中分享了他当前最依赖的5款效率工具，涵盖专注管理、在线业务构建、AI写作等场景。视频不仅列出应用清单，更结合他个人从医生到创作者再到创业者的转型经验，解释了每款工具如何服务于“雄心大于时间”的人群。对于想优化工作流、提升产出效率的观众来说，这是一份来自实战者的可信推荐，尤其适合关注个人成长与副业变现的群体。
items.summary_en: In this video, Ali Abdaal shares the top 5 productivity apps he currently relies on, covering focus management, online business building, AI writing, and more. Beyond a simple list, he draws on his personal journey from doctor to creator to entrepreneur to explain how each tool serves people with more ambition than time. For viewers looking to optimize their workflow and boost output, this is a trustworthy recommendation from a practitioner, especially suited for those interested in personal growth and side-hustle monetization.

items.title_cn: 我在20多岁对自由的误解
items.title_en: What I got wrong about freedom in my 20s
items.summary_cn: Ali Abdaal在这期成长视频中坦诚反思自己20多岁时对“自由”的理解偏差——曾以为自由就是摆脱朝九晚五、追求无限闲暇，却发现真正的自由来自掌控时间的能力与内在的充实感。视频结合个人经历与实用方法论，探讨如何从“逃避式自由”转向“建设性自由”，对正处在职业探索期或追求生活方式的年轻人极具启发。值得一看，因为它戳破了一个常见幻觉：没有方向的时间自由，反而会带来焦虑与空虚。
items.summary_en: In this growth video, Ali Abdaal candidly reflects on how he misunderstood 'freedom' in his 20s—thinking it meant escaping the 9-to-5 and maximizing leisure, only to discover that true freedom comes from the ability to control your time and a sense of inner fulfillment. Drawing on personal experience and practical frameworks, he explores the shift from 'escapist freedom' to 'constructive freedom.' This is highly relevant for young people navigating career exploration or lifestyle design, as it debunks a common illusion: time freedom without direction leads to anxiety and emptiness.

items.title_cn: 初学者必看的5本商业书籍
items.title_en: Top 5 business books for beginners
items.summary_cn: 阿里·阿布达尔在这期视频中为商业新手精选了5本必读商业书籍，帮助你在创业和商业思维上快速入门。无论你是想打造六位数在线业务，还是提升商业素养，这份书单都能为你提供实用框架和启发。视频描述中还附带了作者自己的MBA替代课程和生产力系统等资源链接，适合渴望用知识加速成长的初学者。
items.summary_en: In this video, Ali Abdaal shares his top 5 business books for beginners, offering a curated reading list to help you quickly get started with entrepreneurship and business thinking. Whether you want to build a six-figure online business or improve your business literacy, these books provide practical frameworks and inspiration. The description also includes links to his MBA alternative course and productivity system, making it ideal for beginners eager to accelerate their growth through knowledge.

items.title_cn: 医学生如何月入3000英镑：我的副业成长之路
items.title_en: How I made £3,000 a month as a medical student
items.summary_cn: Ali Abdaal分享自己在医学院期间月入3000英镑的亲身经历，揭秘如何在不耽误学业的前提下，通过在线业务和副业实现可观收入。视频不仅展示具体方法，更传递了可复制的成长思维与时间管理策略，适合渴望在学业或主业之外探索收入来源的年轻人。值得看的原因在于：它打破了“学生只能专注学习”的固有认知，提供了真实可操作的副业起步路径，并强调 productivity 与商业思维的结合，激励观众主动设计自己的生活方式。
items.summary_en: Ali Abdaal shares his personal experience of earning £3,000 a month while studying medicine, revealing how he built a lucrative side income through online business without neglecting his studies. The video not only outlines specific methods but also conveys replicable growth mindset and time management strategies, ideal for young people eager to explore income streams beyond their main studies or job. It's worth watching because it challenges the stereotype that students should only focus on studying, offers a realistic and actionable path to starting a side hustle, and emphasizes combining productivity with business thinking to inspire viewers to design their own lifestyles.
